events.title: Beauty Way — Intentional Gathering with Liquid Bloom
events.description: Beauty Way returns to The Yoga Barn for an evening ritual woven from tea ceremony, cacao, and sound. The gathering opens with a free-flow tea ceremony (18:00–19:00), moves into a ceremonial cacao opening (19:00–19:30), and closes with a live DJ set by Liquid Bloom (19:30–21:15). Liquid Bloom — the project of Amani Friend, one half of the project Desert Dwellers — is known for his Earth-medicine playlists and ceremonial dancefloor weaving: deep organic bass, sacred instrument textures, and devotional vocal samples layered into long-form journeys. He performs regularly on the BaliSpirit and Beloved Festivals circuit and has released multiple albums in the conscious music space. Barefoot floor, no alcohol, all welcome.

events.title: Full-Day Shamanic Breathwork Immersion with Levi Banner
events.description: A full-day breathwork immersion at The Yoga Barn led by Levi Banner — Ubud-based cacao ceremonialist, certified Shamanic Astrologer, and breathwork facilitator who has led ceremonies in Bali since 2013. The full-day format moves through morning activation into afternoon integration: conscious connected breathing held with live instrument accompaniment, emotional release, group sharing, and integration practices drawn from Levi's Shamanic Astrology lineage. This extended format allows for deeper journeying than single-session breathwork — expect full somatic completion before the close. Levi has led multiple sold-out sessions at Yoga Barn this season (Jul 26, Aug 1, Aug 30). Limited capacity. Wear comfortable layers; bring a journal.
